content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (§ 2.1, p0012).**

- **Issue:** § 2.1 binds us to a three-year, USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay commitment "without reduction or termination rights" — the rule's walk-away scenario, not merely short of preferred.
- **Internal conflicts:** § 12.3 has Vendor acknowledge we made no minimum-volume commitment, and § 9.4 gives us 30-day convenience termination with fees owed only for Services delivered.
- **Redline (validated, preferred level):** replaces the commitment with "Customer will pay only for Services used or ordered during the applicable term. Customer has no minimum purchase, take-or-pay, or shortfall obligation," matching precedent seed-mincommit, with the 12-month/30-day/true-up fallback offered in the comment.
